patches.reason: A card is text such as "A♠", whose first character is its rank and second its suit; card[0] and card[1] read them. The functions take the deck as a parameter, whose type the converter cannot tell, so the converted index read the text as a list and stopped the script. substring takes the same one-character texts.

The demo asks for the simple card game or more examples in a loop whose end flag nothing sets, so the session never ended; the legacy player ended the script by closing it. As in ShockYourself's end-session, the question also offers End, which leaves the loop and ends the session (owner decision).
